text.en:
Section 5 of Presidential Decree No. 231 otherwise known as the Local Tax Code, is hereby
amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 5. Common limitations on the taxing powers of local governments. The exercise of the taxing powers of
provinces, cities, municipalities and barrios shall not extend to the imposition of the following:
1. Taxes on the business of persons engaged in the printing and publication of any newspaper, magazine,
review or bulletin appearing at regular intervals and having fixed prices for subscription and sale, and which is
not published primarily for the purpose of publishing advertisements."

All provisions of laws, decrees, executive orders, rules or regulations inconsistent with this
Decree are hereby amended, modified or repealed accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
